name: Shizzle's Flyer
label: Quest
description: Shizzle's Flyer: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I got stranded here, and I'm absolutely horrible at finding my way around. I'd take a gryphon or wind rider back to Gadgetzan, but those beasts just scare me to death.

So, will you help me? All I have left to build is the wings, and I was thinking that the webby scales from the pterrordax and diemetradon would be perfect. There's no way I'm going to go up against one of those, but you look pretty tough. Why don't you give it a try?

clips.title: Progress
paras: Every great vehicle needs a name... I was thinking I'd call it... Pwned!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Yes, these scales are perfect. I should be able to get this flyer off the ground with these scales for sure!
